# Real bulks

## read results
```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
output_dirs <- list.files('./', full.names = T)

res <- lapply(output_dirs, function(i){
  
  path <- paste0(i,'/results_metric.rds')
  if(!file.exists(path)){
    return(NULL)
  }
  metrics <- readRDS(path)
  
  method <- unique(metrics$runtimes$method)
  bulk_ds <- unique(metrics$runtimes$bulk_ds)
  sc_ds <- unique(metrics$runtimes$sc_ds)
  
  if(sc_ds == 'HaoCleaned-sampled'){
    deconv.results <- metrics$deconv.results |> 
      as.data.frame() |> 
      rownames_to_column(var='sample') |> 
      pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = 'celltype', values_to = 'proportion.estimated') 
  
    if(bulk_ds == 'hoek_purified'){
      # remove T subtypes, because their estimates have been summed up already in the pipeline
      #deconv.results <- deconv.results |> subset(!celltype %in% c('T cells CD4 conv','T cells CD8','Tregs'))
    }
    
    gt <- metrics$facs_ground_truth |>
      as.data.frame() |>
      rownames_to_column(var='celltype') |>
      pivot_longer(-celltype, names_to = 'sample', values_to = 'proportion.purified')
    
    df_long <- deconv.results |> 
      left_join(gt, by = join_by(sample, celltype)) |>
      mutate(proportion.purified = ifelse(is.na(proportion.purified), 0, proportion.purified),
             method = method,
             bulk_ds = bulk_ds) 
    
    df_purified_info <- df_long |> 
      subset(proportion.purified == 1) |> 
      mutate(purified_celltype = celltype) |>
      select(purified_celltype, sample)
    
    df_long <- df_long |> left_join(df_purified_info, by = join_by(sample))
    
    return(df_long)  
  }
})

data <- bind_rows(res)
data$celltype <- recode(data$celltype,
                        'T cell' = 'T cells',
                        'T cells CD4 conv' = 'CD4 T cells',
                        'T cells CD4' = 'CD4 T cells',
                        'T cells CD8' = 'CD8 T cells')

data$purified_celltype <- recode(data$purified_celltype,
                        'T cell' = 'T cells',
                        'T cells CD4 conv' = 'CD4 T cells',
                        'T cells CD4' = 'CD4 T cells',
                        'T cells CD8' = 'CD8 T cells')

```


## circle plots
```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)

dataset <- "hoek_purified"

pdf(paste0("./", dataset, "_spillover_improved.pdf"), width = 6, height = 6)

m <- 'rectangle'
  message("Plotting method: ", m)

  # Filter and summarise
  resultDf <- data %>%
    filter(bulk_ds == dataset,
           method == m,
           purified_celltype != "Neutrophils")
  if(dataset == 'hoek_purified'){
    resultDf <- resultDf |> subset(!celltype %in% c('CD4 T cells', 'CD8 T cells', 'Tregs'))
  }
  migration <- resultDf %>%
    group_by(purified_celltype, celltype) %>%
    summarise(estimate = mean(proportion.estimated, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  migration_mat <- migration %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = celltype, values_from = estimate) %>%
    column_to_rownames("purified_celltype") %>%
    as.matrix()

  # Ratios
  noise_ratio <- migration %>%
    mutate(type = ifelse(celltype == purified_celltype, "signal", "noise")) %>%
    group_by(type) %>%
    summarise(estimate = sum(estimate, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = estimate) %>%
    mutate(noise_ratio = noise / (signal + noise)) %>%
    pull(noise_ratio)

  # Colors
  celltypes <- union(rownames(migration_mat), colnames(migration_mat))
  colors <- setNames(
    colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set3"))(length(celltypes)),
    celltypes
  )

  # Circos parameters
  circos.clear()
  circos.par(
    gap.degree = 6,
    start.degree = 90,
    track.margin = c(0.01, 0.01),
    cell.padding = c(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

  chordDiagram(
    x = migration_mat,
    grid.col = color_palette,
    transparency = 0.35,
    directional = -1,
    annotationTrack = "grid",
    preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = 0.08)
  )

  # Labels
circos.trackPlotRegion(
  track.index = 1,
  bg.border = NA,
  panel.fun = function(x, y) {
    sector_name <- get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
    circos.text(
      x = mean(get.cell.meta.data("xlim")),
      y = get.cell.meta.data("ylim")[1] - 5.0,
      labels = sector_name,
      facing = "clockwise",
      cex = 1.2,          # 🔸 increase from 0.7 → 1.1
      font = 2,           # bold labels
      col = "black",
      niceFacing = TRUE,
      adj = c(0, 0.5)
    )
  }
)
text(0, 0, paste0("", round(noise_ratio, 2)),
     cex = 2, col = "gray30", font = 2)
circos.clear()
  # Center text
  circos.clear()
  plot.new()
  par(usr = c(-1, 1, -1, 1))
  text(0, 0.1, m, cex = 1.8, font = 2)



dev.off()
```


# Pseudobulks

## read results
```{r}
output_dirs <- list.files('./', full.names = T)

res <- lapply(output_dirs, function(i){
  path <- paste0(i, '/deconvolution_spillover.rds')
  if(!file.exists(path)){
    return(NULL)
  }
  deconv_res <- readRDS(path)
  method <- strsplit(basename(i),'_')[[1]][1]
  reference <- strsplit(basename(i),'_')[[1]][2]
  simulation_sc <- strsplit(basename(i),'_')[[1]][3]
  
  estimated_fractions <- deconv_res$deconvolution
  true_fractions <- deconv_res$true_cell_fractions
  
  estimated_fractions_long <- estimated_fractions |> 
    data.frame(check.names = F) |> 
    rownames_to_column(var = 'sample') |> 
    pivot_longer(-sample,names_to = 'cell_type', values_to = 'proportion.estimated') |>
    mutate(cell_type = gsub('\\.', ' ', cell_type))
  
  true_fractions_long <- true_fractions |> 
    t() |>
    data.frame(check.names = F) |> 
    rownames_to_column(var = 'sample') |> 
    pivot_longer(-sample,names_to = 'cell_type', values_to = 'proportion.true') |>
    mutate(sample = sub("_[0-9]+(?=(_|$))",'',sample, perl=TRUE))
  
  both_df <- left_join(estimated_fractions_long, true_fractions_long, by = join_by(sample, cell_type))
  both_df$method <- method
  both_df$purified_celltype <- gsub('_',' ',sapply(strsplit(both_df$sample, '__'), `[[`, 2))
  
  return(both_df)
  
})

data_sim <- bind_rows(res)

data_sim$cell_type <- recode(data_sim$cell_type,
                        'T cells CD4 conv' = 'CD4 T cells',
                        'T cells CD8' = 'CD8 T cells')

data_sim$purified_celltype <- recode(data_sim$purified_celltype,
                        'T cells CD4 conv' = 'CD4 T cells',
                        'T cells CD8' = 'CD8 T cells')


```

## circle plots

```{r}
## circle plots (improved pseudobulk version)
library(tidyverse)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)

pdf(paste0("./Hao_spillover_improved.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)

for (m in unique(data_sim$method)) {
  message("Plotting method: ", m)

  # Filter & summarise
  resultDf <- data_sim %>%
    filter(method == m)

  migration <- resultDf %>%
    group_by(purified_celltype, cell_type) %>%
    summarise(estimate = mean(proportion.estimated, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  migration_mat <- migration %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = cell_type, values_from = estimate) %>%
    column_to_rownames("purified_celltype") %>%
    as.matrix()

  # Calculate noise ratio
  noise_ratio <- migration %>%
    mutate(type = ifelse(cell_type == purified_celltype, "signal", "noise")) %>%
    group_by(type) %>%
    summarise(estimate = sum(estimate, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = estimate) %>%
    mutate(noise_ratio = noise / (signal + noise)) %>%
    pull(noise_ratio)

  # Define consistent colors
  celltypes <- union(rownames(migration_mat), colnames(migration_mat))
  colors_use <- colors[names(colors) %in% celltypes]
  if (length(colors_use) < length(celltypes)) {
    # fill missing colors with palette
    missing <- setdiff(celltypes, names(colors_use))
    extra_cols <- setNames(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "Set3"))(length(missing)), missing)
    colors_use <- c(colors_use, extra_cols)
  }

  # Circos setup (matching the real bulk style)
  circos.clear()
  circos.par(
    gap.degree = 3,
    start.degree = 90,
    track.margin = c(0, 0),
    cell.padding = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
    canvas.xlim = c(-0.9, 0.9),
    canvas.ylim = c(-0.9, 0.9)
  )

  chordDiagram(
    x = migration_mat,
    grid.col = color_palette,
    transparency = 0.3,
    directional = -1,
    annotationTrack = "grid",
    preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = 0.08)
  )

  # Add clean, bold sector labels
  circos.trackPlotRegion(
    track.index = 1,
    bg.border = NA,
    panel.fun = function(x, y) {
      sector_name <- get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
      circos.text(
        x = mean(get.cell.meta.data("xlim")),
        y = get.cell.meta.data("ylim")[1] - 5.0,
        labels = sector_name,
        facing = "clockwise",
        cex = 1.2,
        font = 2,
        col = "black",
        niceFacing = TRUE,
        adj = c(0, 0.5)
      )
    }
  )
    # Center text
  text(0, 0, paste0("", round(noise_ratio, 2)),
     cex = 2, col = "gray30", font = 2)

  circos.clear()
  plot.new()
  par(usr = c(-1, 1, -1, 1))
  text(0, 0.1, m, cex = 1.8, font = 2)


}

dev.off()
```
